items.title: haydenschmitty/floorplan
items.why: It is a great tool for early CS students to visualize and understand complex codebases easily.
items.summary: An open-source project that uses LLMs like Claude or Codex to generate an interactive, plain-English visual map of any codebase.

items.title: heydamir/unslop
items.why: It is a practical AI tool that helps clean up unstyled front-end code generated by AI models.
items.summary: An extension skill for Claude Code that automatically refines generic AI-generated web interface code into clean, professionally styled designs.

items.title: wangzan101/Mika
items.why: It shows a practical application of AI agents performing everyday actions directly on mobile devices.
items.summary: An open-source Android app that uses an on-device AI agent to automatically interact with smartphone apps and websites.

items.title: elvarofficial/teardown
items.why: It offers an interactive AI tool for breaking down and visualizing physical hardware systems.
items.summary: A tool for Claude Code that creates interactive 3D simulations of machines so you can disassemble and examine their components.

items.title: deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype
items.why: It offers a hands-on look at how cutting-edge open-source AI agents are designed.
items.summary: A prototype framework by DeepSeek aimed at creating autonomous AI agents capable of multi-step planning and task execution.

items.title: OpenBMB/MiniCPM-OCR
items.why: It highlights a practical open-source AI project focused on image-to-text processing.
items.summary: A lightweight open-source optical character recognition model designed for fast, accurate text extraction from images.

items.title: storytold/craft-anything
items.why: It is a valuable learning resource tailored for beginners who want to understand software architecture hands-on.
items.summary: An educational open-source resource designed to teach fundamental software engineering concepts by guiding you to build your own tools from scratch.

items.title: Arjun-Ingole/hop
items.why: It simplifies setting up a Linux development environment, which is essential for computer science students.
items.summary: An open-source installer that sets up Linux alongside Windows without needing to flash a physical USB drive.

items.title: Show HN: HackerBooks – HackerTube, but for books mentioned on HN
items.why: It serves as a helpful collection of top-recommended CS and software engineering books.
items.summary: A curated directory generated using Claude that catalogs thousands of programming and technical books recommended across Hacker News discussions.

items.title: No AI, 52 min. Build all Linux Files utils in C by Hand [video]
items.why: It provides a clear, practical lesson on basic C programming and underlying operating system tools.
items.summary: A coding demonstration showing how to write core Linux command-line utilities in C from scratch without assistance from AI tools.

items.title: Backdoor in Claude Code for VS Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace
items.why: It highlights an essential cybersecurity warning for developers using AI extension marketplaces.
items.summary: A security advisory warning developers about a malicious backdoor discovered inside an unofficial Claude Code extension listed on the Cursor marketplace.

items.title: AI agent swarms in Minecraft fail to build civilization, drown in bureaucracy
items.why: It gives you a fun, intuitive perspective on current limitations in multi-agent AI systems.
items.summary: An experiment deploying multiple autonomous AI agents in Minecraft revealed that without clear hierarchy, agents got stuck in bureaucratic decision loops rather than building structures.

items.title: Postgres 19 is late, and it's AI's fault
items.why: It offers insight into how widespread AI code tools impact real-world software engineering processes.
items.summary: A discussion on how code contributions generated by AI models have increased review workloads and contributed to delays in major open-source releases like PostgreSQL 19.

items.title: Iran war live: Tankers hit in Hormuz; Trump again says conflict to end soon
items.why: It keeps you informed on major global events affecting worldwide trade and geopolitics.
items.summary: Oil tankers were hit by mines in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting international concern over energy shipping lanes amidst ongoing military tensions.
